label: Stage 12 — Vera → Observatorio de Calar Alto, 166.6 km
day_key_note: OFFICIAL MORNING READ (tier-3 archive). Vera to the Calar Alto Observatory, 166.6 km and 4,568 m. Climbing starts almost immediately — Alto del Cabecico (8.3 km at 3.3%) from km 7.7, then the long drag of Collado García (18.5 km at 2.4%), then the decisive pair: Alto de Velefique, 13.1 km at 7.2% opening on double-digit ramps before easing, a short descent, and the 16.9 km haul to Calar Alto at 5.
reflection: The break won and the model missed the winner, but this was a far better day than Valdelinares. Jakob Omrzel — twenty years old — went clear and held 1:56 on Berrade and 2:13 on Buitrago, with Mas the first GC man home in 6th at 2:56, taking 27 seconds out of Roglic, Gall and Carapaz.
